title: Hiring pipeline pulse + onboarding buddy check (Jul 10 2025)
body:
Attendees: Maya Chen (notes), Sam Rodriguez, Priya Kapoor, Liam O'Connor, Zara Ahmed

Agenda:
- Quick hiring velocity check (open roles + interviews this week)
- Interview debrief highlights (senior infra, infra IC manager)
- Onboarding sync: buddy assignments + first-week checklist gaps
- Team health pulse: ramping concerns, capacity hits
- Action items + owners

Summary / TL;DR:
- Hiring pace still slower than target: 5 open IC roles in infra/platform, 3 active candidates in loop, 1 offer extended (senior infra eng). Need to accelerate screening + better recruiter cal on expectations.
- Interview feedback indicates loop is too long for senior infra manager candidates (we lost one due to 2-week delay). Trim one round or move to synchronous panel for senior hires.
- Onboarding: new cohort starting 07/21 — buddy coverage mostly assigned but a few overlaps and one missing hardware workstation; investigate with infra provisioning.
- Team health: a few engineers reporting high context-switching due to oncall overlap and ramping new hires. Short-term mitigation: reassign one code-review-heavy project and add temporary pair rotating.

Hiring velocity snapshot (notes, not formal metrics):
- Open reqs (eng): INFRA-IC (3), PLATFORM-IC (2), SERVING-SENIOR (1 manager), DX-ENG (1)
- Interviews scheduled this week: 6 onsite loops (3 infra, 2 platform, 1 dx)
- Offers: 1 extended (senior infra IC), verbally accepted, written offer in progress
- Pipeline choke points: screening backlog (~10 candidates) and recruiter bandwidth (R1: Priya flagged recruiter overlap with another priority)

Interview debrief highlights (by role):
- Senior infra IC (candidate: C-41) — strong systems background, great on distributed tracing design. Interviewers: Sam, Priya, Liam. Concerns: limited direct team leadership experience. Outcome: recommend hire for IC-level. Next: extend offer (Sam to confirm comp band).
- Infra manager (candidate: M-12) — good org design + people ops experience, rejected due to long loop (candidate accepted another offer). Discussion: shorten manager loop to 2 interviews + hiring manager meet. Action: Maya to draft new manager loop template.
- Platform eng (candidate: P-07) — green on core skills but flagged slower debugging; need more targeted hands-on exercise earlier in loop. Action: Liam to create 30-min troubleshooting exercise and add to screen.

Onboarding sync notes:
- New cohort start: 2025-07-21 (4 hires: 2 infra IC, 1 platform IC, 1 DX).
- Buddy assignments: assigned as follows — Infra hires: Zara + Sam; Platform: Liam; DX: Priya. (Note: Zara will be on vacation week 2 of onboarding; Sam to cover overlap.)
- Hardware / accounts: one workstation pending (asset tag request queued, see linked ticket ENG-asset-213). Priya to escalate with infra provisioning.
- Onboarding checklist gaps observed in previous cohort:
  - Lack of clear first-week small project (most new hires spent too much time reading docs)
  - Low visibility on expectation for week 2 pairing slots
  - Missing explicit cost/allocation overview for Dedicated vs Hosted infra — useful for product-context orientation
- Quick fixes agreed:
  - Create a "first 2-week micro-project" template (owner: Zara, due 2025-07-17)
  - Add explicit schedule for pairing slots to onboarding calendar (owner: Sam, due 2025-07-14)
  - Add a 30-min "platform economics" slot to orientation (owner: Priya, invite sent)

Team health pulse (anecdotal):
- Reported by 3 ICs: feeling stretched due to simultaneous oncall rotation and ramp tasks. Particularly noisy in serving-runtime team where rollout + canary issues coincide with headcount churn.
- One skip-level note: new managers are triaging too many hiring admin tasks — consider centralizing offer logistics into recruiting ops.
- Positive: cross-team mentorship program is showing early wins (two pairs reported faster onboarding this month). Keep expanding.

Decisions made:
- Shorten manager interview loop (Maya will produce template).
- Add hands-on triage exercise to earlier screen for Platform candidates.
- Buddy coverage finalized (Sam to cover Zara's vacation overlap).

Unresolved / questions:
- How to measure "quality of hire" for infra roles faster than 6 months? (idea: add 3-month technical outcomes + 1:1 calibration signals)
- Should we increase recruiter headcount or reallocate recruiting ops to specific subteams for higher throughput? (Priya to run cost vs time analysis)

Action items (owner + due):
- Maya: Draft manager interview loop template and share with hiring managers (due 2025-07-15).
- Liam: Build 30-min troubleshooting exercise for platform screens + add to Screen repo (due 2025-07-13).
- Zara: Draft 2-week micro-project template for new hires (due 2025-07-17).
- Sam: Publish pairing-slot schedule to onboarding calendar; cover buddy gap week 2 (due 2025-07-14).
- Priya: Escalate workstation provisioning (ENG-asset-213) and add "platform economics" slot to orientation deck (due 2025-07-12).
- Recruiting Ops (cc: HR): Provide headcount vs recruiter-effort summary for July (linked ticket HR-129) (due 2025-07-20).

Notes to self (Maya):
- Follow up with hiring manager on comp band for C-41 — we need to avoid losing to FAANG comps.
- Capture sample micro-projects from serving-runtime and console team for reuse.
- Consider a 1-hour "calibration lab" once a month for interviewers to reduce inconsistent feedback.

Related links / refs in meeting:
- Onboarding playbook (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Onboarding+Playbook
- Candidate tracker (internal sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CandidateTracker
- Hiring issues: ENG-4821, HR-129

End of notes.

----
Raw fragments that didn't make the polished notes (working thoughts):
- "Would be nice to have a recruiter 'triage' slot twice/week to clear screening backlog"
- "We should experiment with async home assignments for Platform before onsite"
- "Maybe try a shadowing week for buddies rather than jump-in code reviews first week"
